rationale: The agent correctly verified identity using full name and zip, located the correct user, and identified a likely most-recent order. However, it stated the payment method used for the order (“charged to your Mastercard ending in 1065”) without clear support from the shown tool output; the order details snippet did not include payment data, so this appears inferred from the stored payment method, which violates the no-fabrication policy. The total amount stated matches the sum of item prices, but without explicit totals/taxes shown, asserting “total amount paid” could also be risky. Due to the unsupported payment-method claim, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
